'''The Evil One''' was a face card that was a part of the standard [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] deck. It held a value of negative fifteen.

==Behind the scenes==
Like most of the other sabacc face cards, it is equivalent to one of the 22 Major Arcana in tarot cards, in this case The Devil. The Devil is a symbol of urge of selfish acts and impulsive violence, sexuality, temptation and deals with the devil. Many of such are associated with [[The Dark Side (article)|The Dark Side]].
